{{Top|leg}}
'''Wishbone''' was a nickname used among [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]/[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]. It referred to the fighter's twin engine nacelles, which resembled a wishbone.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
